title: ISS cabin air grab samples, Increment 71 (May to September 2024): compound concentrations
documentation: JSC Toxicology and Environmental Chemistry Group, Memorandum TOX-SW-2025-02, 'Toxicological Assessment of ISS Air and Water Quality: March 26, 2024 to September 23, 2024 (Increment 71) Including NG-21 Ingress and Boeing-CFT Ascent', dated October 21, 2025, 13 PDF pages; source PDF sha256 96356e314a1d88d29a5e6bb55d690f225aadb1709ce00827cac03a8b1c2ef245, 1,114,979 bytes
Table 1 (summary T-values and alcohols), PDF page 2
mission: ISS Increment 71; returned on Crew-8 and Boeing-CFT
instrument: Mini grab sample containers (mGSCs) analyzed on the ground by the JSC Environmental Chemistry Laboratory (GC-MS TO-15 modified, GC-FID, TGA)
cadence: Ten samples on six dates: eight routine samples on 2024-05-08, 2024-06-17, 2024-07-22 and 2024-09-11 (two locations each), one Boeing Starliner cabin ascent sample (2024-06-06) and one NG-21 Cygnus ingress sample (2024-08-06)
timestamp_timezone: Dates and times as printed; the table's last row gives the GMT day of year for each sample, kept in gmt_day_of_year.

location.description: Sample location (Lab, Columbus, SM, JPM, Cabin of Starliner, Cygnus)

gmt_day_of_year.description: As printed in the GMT row

reporting_limit.description: For '<x' cells: the laboratory reporting limit x

qualifier.description: below_reporting_limit, not_found (no unknown peak above threshold), reported_by_gc_fid, not_reported

source_line.description: Line in the pdftotext -layout output, for audit

preprocessing: Transcribed from the PDF text layer (pdftotext from poppler, -layout) by transcribe_tox_inc71.py in this folder; no OCR and no reading of figures. Every printed cell is kept verbatim in 'printed'; 'value' is the number with thousands separators removed, empty when the cell is not a number; 'qualifier' names the non-numeric cases. The script stops if a table row does not have one cell per sample column.
license: US Government work. NASA material is generally not subject to copyright in the United States (NASA media usage guidelines, https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/). Credit NASA as the source; no NASA logo or insignia is used (NASA-SOURCES.md section 4).
provenance_note: REPLAY of published NASA laboratory results; sample dates kept.
is_not: Grab samples, one point in time each, not a continuous sensor feed.
Carbon dioxide here is a grab-sample value in mg/m3, not the one-hour average the CO2 limit uses.

consumers.use: Golden case checked against the source: the concentrations here divided by the 180-day SMACs (JSC 20584, catalog EV03) must give the T-values NASA printed in iss_air_inc71_mgsc_t_values.csv (0.2 to 0.7 routine, 0.8 for the NG-21 ingress with 180-day SMACs).

consumers.component: simulators/habitat CO, VOC and ammonia feeds
consumers.use: Real nominal levels for the SIM generators of the CO (1.3 to 2.2 mg/m3) and VOC channels, cited instead of invented.
